title: Where is it? (Placing Objects)
subject: English Language
objectives: Use prepositions to describe where things are

blocks.md: We use words to say where things and animals are. Look at these examples:

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The bird is sitting in the tree.

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The lion is in the bush.

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The leopard is on the branch of a tree.

lines.speaker: Pupil
lines.text: The old man is sitting outside his house.

blocks.md:
Now look at these sentences:

- Many pictures are **on** the walls of the classroom.
- The cat is sitting **on** the old mat.
- The old woman is working **in** the farm.
**Remember:** Use **'in'** for containers and enclosures (in the bush, in the tree). Use **'on'** for surfaces (on the wall, on the mat). Use **'outside'** for buildings.

quiz.explain: The bird is sitting 'in the tree'.
The lion is in the bush.
The cat is sitting on the old mat.

quiz.q: The old woman is working ___ the farm.
quiz.explain: We say 'in the farm' for enclosed areas.
